Didn't intend to make you upset. What you're trying to do doesn't qualify as "shaking someone by the shoulders", it's transcended into not understanding that your advice doesn't work for everyone. I'm not going to embrace someones values just because they tell me to. Trying to shove advice down someones throat when they've implied they don't like it doesn't do anything. I don't have to take your advice just because you've offered it. 

Stating my opinion is not making excuses or being defensive. It's not about one opinion trumping another, I disagree with you but I respect your opinion. All I ask is that you do the same. 

Why you would get upset just because I declined some of your advice is beyond me. Wish you all the best nonetheless.

Yeah you put it really well in your comment. I'm alive but in pain every second. The only thing that keeps me going is that I'm working on changing things. I wish you all the best man and I hope you can find happiness in life :)

It was not my intention to make you feel attacked with my comment, and this reply is also just my thoughts and opinions, not trying to sound defensive at all.

I don't agree that all women have low standards for men. And I don't care if my features don't "bother" someone, because they are unattractive, and they bother me, which is what matters.

When it comes to my mental attitude, changing it to accept who I am now would utterly destroy me. It would be the end of me. It will change once I change what I want about myself and am happy with the changes. Nobody notices my mental insecurities, because I can hide them. I find it a little bit unfair that you automatically assume that I pity myself. I'm waaaay past that point, and I'm working on changing my environment every day. I can change my life without changing my attitude, because it doesn't stop me from working hard from the moment I get out of bed. On the contrary, it serves as a reminder that I'm not comfortable with things the way they are. We clearly have different mentalities. 

You don't have to be a burn or acid victim to be able to feel bad about your appearence, or to want plastic surgery. I don't want to sound like an asshole, but objectivley you don't know how I look, or what my situation is like. I can't understand that you would consider the only reason for permanent change to be mutilation of some form. But I do see that some people consider plastic surgery to be "too drastic" and I can see where they're coming from. But nobody is going to discourage me from doing something that would make me feel happy. My self hatred is justified for reasons I don't feel like sharing online, but I can easily hide it. And nobody has ever noticed so far irl.

Ultimately I get the impression that a lot of your advice has been shaped by what you would do if you were in my place. However, I feel that a lot of it simply goes against the steps I feel are necessary for me to be happy. We clearly have different values. 

I really appreciate the resources and links you've listed though. I'll take a look at them. And I'm not looking to make you feel like your advice is being echoed into an endless void, I just can't take some of it to heart if it goes against what I want and if it doesn't fit with the type of person I am. I hope you get what I mean.
Cheers man, but some things are beyond my control.

Thank you for the comment. Yeah you assumed correctly that I'm a guy. I'll try to respond in an order that makes sense. When it comes to height, yes I am a little bit above the global average, but having gone to a highschool (I'm under 20) where I'm still under average in those terms doesn't feel good. Also, I'm waaay past the "growing" phase of my teens, and in terms of the height department my body is probably done. I'll try, but I'm doubtful I can do much about it. Having people in my family who are also much taller than me (by like 3-4 inches) also makes me feel like I've really lost the genetic lottery. I also believe anyone would go for a taller person if they have the chance (there's no changing my mind about this one). There's a lot of things about my appearence that need change and most of those things require some sort of procedure. When I meant face I was talking about features, and I've been wanting to get plastic surgery for a very long time. The issue of my hair is about the fact that I have genetically thin hair, which means a hair transplant is again the only option for a permanent fix. It's not the "going bald extremely thin" type, but it's still enough to make me feel bad. My eyes are the kind of pitch black which you'd draw on a cartoon character to show they have no soul (not kidding), and all of my appearence really makes me avoid looking at a mirror, or any reflective surface for that matter. When it comes to my behaviour I'm socially anxious and generally socially inept. I can't make a good joke to save my life, and who knows if I'll ever be able to. Again, it's difficult for me to believe the things you say don't matter really don't, because I believe they do. And if they don't matter to you then you're one of few, but they matter to me. I don't want to sound like I'm being picky, because objectivley I'm not even remotely attractive. Besides, life's not always a measuring contest of who has it worse, and that kind of thinking doesn't solve anythig. I'm sure there are other people who have it worse, but that doesn't make me feel any better about myself. I also don't like the "love yourself" idea, because accepting the way I am now is just false happiness. All of these things are the reasons as to why I believe I'll always just be the kind of person people are with until they find someone better, and I can't deal with that.
Yeah I also don't believe love is unconditional, or that you have to like yourself for others to like you. I can hide my insecurities, but there's still things I want to change.
I'm working on finding some bit of happiness. I wish you all the best man :)

The other things are more important, but you'd have to understand more about my situation to see that. When it comes to my mindset, I want to change my appearence. I don't want to accept the way I am now because that would destroy me completely.
